rubric: Mouth - Ulcers inside cheek or lips
path: Mouth > Mouth - Ulcers inside cheek or lips
notes: Painful aphthous or syphilitic ulcers. Mercurius for offensive smell and salivation; Borax for tender ulcers that bleed easily.; Worse from salty food, touch, night

rubric: Mouth - Dryness without thirst
path: Mouth > Mouth - Dryness without thirst
notes: Strange contradiction: mouth dry but no desire to drink. Nux moschata is highly specific.; Morning on waking, during fever

rubric: Mouth - Foul odor, halitosis
path: Mouth > Mouth - Foul odor, halitosis
notes: Foul breath from dental decay, infections, or digestive issues. Merc and Kreosote are key remedies.; Worse in morning, with coated tongue

rubric: Mouth - Salivation profuse
path: Mouth > Mouth - Salivation profuse
notes: Excessive drooling especially in mouth ulcers, teething or during sleep. Mercurius is the strongest remedy here.; During sleep, fever, teething

rubric: Mouth - Burning sensation in tongue or palate
path: Mouth > Mouth - Burning sensation in tongue or palate
notes: Burning mouth syndrome, menopausal or nutritional causes. Arsenicum and Sulphur are highly indicated.; Worse from spicy food, hot drinks

rubric: Mouth - Metallic taste
path: Mouth > Mouth - Metallic taste
notes: Metallic taste common in toxic states or ulcerative mouth issues. Mercurius and Phosphorus are top choices.; With fever, medications, ulcers

rubric: Mouth - Bluish discoloration of gums
path: Mouth > Mouth - Bluish discoloration of gums
notes: Bluish gums seen in metal toxicity (e.g., lead), chronic ulcerative conditions. Plumbum is the leading remedy.; In chronic diseases, lead poisoning, debility

rubric: Mouth - Swelling of gums
path: Mouth > Mouth - Swelling of gums
notes: Swollen, inflamed gums with or without pain. Mercurius and Belladonna are highly effective.; Worse from touch, during fever

rubric: Mouth - Ulcers inside cheek or lips
path: Mouth > Mouth - Ulcers inside cheek or lips
notes: Painful aphthous or syphilitic ulcers. Mercurius for offensive smell and salivation; Borax for tender ulcers that bleed easily.; Worse from salty food, touch, night

rubric: Mouth - Ulcers on tongue or gums
path: Mouth > Mouth - Ulcers on tongue or gums
notes: Painful ulcers with red borders or deep cracks. Nitric acid often for sharp, splinter-like pains.; Worse during fever, hot food

rubric: Mouth - Aphthae in children
path: Mouth > Mouth - Aphthae in children
notes: White patches or ulcers, painful while feeding. Borax is mild and effective in infants.; Worse from sour food, milk, at night

rubric: Teeth - Decay rapid, black, crumbling
path: Mouth > Teeth - Decay rapid, black, crumbling
notes: Rapid caries especially in children. Kreosotum is a key remedy when teeth decay soon after eruption.; Worse at night, sweet food

rubric: Teeth - Pain drawing, tearing, neuralgic
path: Mouth > Teeth - Pain drawing, tearing, neuralgic
notes: Severe dental pain especially during teething. Chamomilla when child is very irritable and sleepless.; Worse at night, from cold air, touch

rubric: Teeth - Grinding of teeth (Bruxism)
path: Mouth > Teeth - Grinding of teeth (Bruxism)
notes: Common in worm infestations, stress, or neurotic children. Cina and Tuberculinum highly effective.; During sleep, with worms or anxiety

rubric: Teeth - Looseness of teeth without pain
path: Mouth > Teeth - Looseness of teeth without pain
notes: Teeth feel loose or fall out without inflammation. Phosphorus and Mercurius help prevent early loss.; With receding gums, old age or bone disease

rubric: Mouth - Obstruction of salivary ducts / stone formation
path: Mouth > Mouth - Obstruction of salivary ducts / stone formation
notes: Blocked salivary glands (e.g., submandibular swelling, sialolithiasis). Calcarea fluor and Silicea help resolve obstruction.; Worse from chewing, before meals

rubric: Mouth - Lips dry, cracked, crusted
path: Mouth > Mouth - Lips dry, cracked, crusted
notes: Chapped lips with crusts, fissures, bleeding. Natrum mur and Petroleum are highly specific for chronic dryness.; Worse in winter, from heat, talking

rubric: Nose - Discharge thick, yellow-green
path: Nose > Nose - Discharge thick, yellow-green
notes: Thick, stringy or mucopurulent nasal catarrh seen in sinusitis or chronic rhinitis. Kali bich and Hydrastis are key remedies.; Worse in morning, in warm room

rubric: Nose - Discharge thin, watery, acrid
path: Nose > Nose - Discharge thin, watery, acrid
notes: Common cold or hay fever with burning watery coryza. Allium cepa affects eyes and nose together.; Worse in open air, evening, spring

rubric: Nose - Obstruction, can’t breathe through nose
path: Nose > Nose - Obstruction, can’t breathe through nose
notes: Nasal blockage due to polyps, turbinate swelling, or allergic rhinitis. Sambucus especially in infants.; Worse at night, during sleep, in children

rubric: Nose - Bleeding, epistaxis
path: Nose > Nose - Bleeding, epistaxis
notes: Bleeding from nose, especially in anaemia, typhoid, or trauma. Hamamelis and Phosphorus help in passive bleeding.; Worse during fever, in summer, after exertion
